articles.summary: $30 million private placement supports commercial team build-out to drive U.S. sales growth; Q3 U.S. sales increased slightly despite significant funding constraints prior to mid-August financing ATLANTA, Nov. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Femasys Inc. (NASDAQ: FEMY), a leading biomedical innovator developing transformative fertility and non-surgical permanent birth control solutions designed to improve the standard of care, expand access, and reduce costs for women worldwide, announces its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and provides a corporate update. Corporate Highlights from 3Q 2026 to date Completed $30 million private placement with potential total proceeds of up to $85 million upon full cash exercise of warrants, to build-out the U.S. commercial team needed to support revenue growth following recent availability of the FemaSeed ® fertility portfolio to OB/GYNs, and to fund the FemBloc ® pivotal trial to support U.S. approval.
